children.innerHTML: Tables are released four weeks ahead, on the first of the month at nine sharp. Email is quickest. For tonight, call and ask about the counter.
We hold tables for ten minutes, then feed the walk-in list. Ring us if the trains are against you.

attributes.alt: The warm glow of the room from the street

children.innerHTML: The old coal yard, past the arches
14 Coal Yard Lane, Shoreditch, London E2 8DY. Two minutes from Hoxton overground, look for the wood store and the chimney that is always working.
There is no sign. There has never been a sign. If you can smell oak smoke, you are close.
On Mondays the room sleeps, but the fire will get up for twelve of your favourite people. One long table, one menu, the kitchen at conversation distance.
